review.notes: Cute sitting grey rabbit with long upright ears, cream belly, tail and ear insides, black eyes (game-rabbit-a had red eyes and pink ears). Tall-eared silhouette distinct from the deer and boar; no ground.

chibi-fruit-blueberry.subject: RESOURCE:FRUIT
chibi-fruit-blueberry.notes: Low blueberry shrub: green leaves around three big dusty-blue berries, soil block removed. Low wide silhouette distinct from the peach tree; blue is neither Teal nor Violet; about 32 x 30 px.

chibi-fruit-pear.subject: RESOURCE:FRUIT
chibi-fruit-pear.notes: Young pear tree with a dark sage dome crown, brown trunk and pale lime-green teardrop pears, grass disc removed. Slim trunk and hanging pears distinct from the round peach tree; about 29 x 39 px.

chibi-game-boar.subject: RESOURCE:GAME
chibi-game-boar.notes: Chunky ash-grey wild boar with a brown bristle crest, cream tusks and a charcoal snout; ears, cheeks and belly carry no pink or red. Distinct low wide silhouette from the deer; bulkier than the deer (about 43 x 42 px) but grey and calm, so it never rivals a unit. Nothing under its hooves.

chibi-game-rabbit.subject: RESOURCE:GAME
chibi-game-rabbit.notes: Cute sitting grey rabbit with long upright ears, cream belly, tail and ear insides, black eyes (game-rabbit-a had red eyes and pink ears). Tall-eared silhouette distinct from the deer and boar; no ground.
